notes.title: YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.42
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.42[/b][/u][/h1][p][i]Various changes and updates based on the feedback received and planned changes in the future of this build[/i][/p][h3][b]
GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added minimum height entry condition for starting Wall Run[/p][/*][*][p]Minor camera rotation and collision behaviour fixes[/p][/*][*][p] Player-enemy collision behaviour adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to player rotation/movement behaviour during attacks.[/p][/*][*][p] Changes to hit properties of certain moves:[/p][p]  * Cheetah Super Attack: Knockback reduced for slash instances[/p][p]  * Lion Air Heavy Attack: added knockdown effect to 3rd hit[/p][p]  * Unarmed Light Attack: minor increase to hit stun duration[/p][p]  * Unarmed Air Dash Attack: increase to fall speed and decrease to hit activation radius[/p][p]  * Launcher Attack: slight decrease to launch force[/p][/*][*][p] Adjustments to Grind Rail collision with player[/p][/*][*][p] Base Grind Rail Speed increased[/p][/*][*][p] Base Sprint Speed increased[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fix to Audio settings being further altered upon exiting the Volume slider screen in certain instances.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fix to some SFX not being affected by audio levels
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ENEMY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustments to Enemy encounter finish camera behaviour[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to Enemy Poise refresh conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to enemy positioning and attack behaviour * Enemy HP values lowered on Medium/Easy difficulties[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]KNOWN BUGS & UPCOMING CHANGES[/h1][p]- Very rare occurrence of Combo Counter not ending upon finalizing a combo.[/p]

notes.title: YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.31
notes.notes:
[h1][b][u]YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.31[/u][/b][/h1][p][i]Various changes and updates based on the feedback received and planned changes in the future of this build[/i][/p][h3][b]
GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tutorial menu added (Interact with VITRA)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to camera zoom in both Parkour and Combat modes[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge direction while not locked on is now relative to camera position[/p][/*][*][p]Momentum adjustments for all parkour modes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor changes to launch pad behaviour[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]ENEMY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added health restoration pickups upon clearing enemy encounters (Higher difficulties have lower drop probability)[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3][b]OPTIMIZATION[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Minor optimization for animations[/p][/*][*][p]Minor optimizations for cutscene loading[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]MISC[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustments to clear stats on Mission Cleared screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]KNOWN BUGS & UPCOMING CHANGES[/h1][p]- Various animation desyncing issues[/p][p]- Additional Camera System rework[/p][p]- Additional Rail Grind System rework[/p][p]- Increased Enemy Reactivity [i][b](More enemy types are planned for the full game which better reflect stance change needs)[/b][/i][/p][p]- Easy Swing Grapple Mode[/p][p]- UI Overhaul [i][b](much is currently placeholder)[/b][/i][/p][p]- Audio continued Overhaul[/p][p]- Various clipping issues[/p][p]- Further Optimization Works[/p][p]- Map Improvements [b][i](However this map does not reflect the maps of the full game, it is purely a separate set piece for the Alpha's gameplay mechanic testing using various assets from our different levels of the game)[/i][/b][i] [/i][/p]

notes.title: YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]YASUKE Pre-Alpha Patch 1.01[/b][/u][/h1][p][i]Various changes and updates based on the feedback received and planned changes in the future of this build[/i][/p][h3][b]
GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][p]- Various movement camera (Automatic Mode) Improvements [b](more to be discussed in upcoming changes)[/b][/p][p]- Adjustments to camera (Automatic Mode) functionality while wall running[/p][p]- Air dashing now cancels out all current momentum and will instantly convert it to your desired direction[/p][p]- Player air control increased[/p][p]- Jumping off rail grinds will cancel *most* momentum and take you in the direction you want to go[/p][p]- Rail grind speed slightly increased [b](more to be discussed in upcoming changes)[/b][/p][p]- Fix to combo count not decreasing in certain circumstances[/p][p][/p][h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][p]-  Main Menu music loop corrected[/p][p]- Tanaka now vocally calls out each stance he switches into[/p][p]- Alongside the callouts, backing audio reflecting the animal can also be heard in each stance switch[/p][p]- Rhino stance now has separate combat effort voice acting[/p][p]- Lowered Combo Counter SFX[/p][p]- New Hit Confirm SFX[/p][p][/p][h3][b]ENEMY[/b][/h3][p]- Enemies have larger health pools on all difficulties[/p][p]- Fix to enemy models rotating quickly in certain circumstances[/p][p][/p][h3][b]VISUALS[/b][/h3][p]- Bloom reduced[/p][p]- Motion Blur reduced[/p][p]- Sprint Speed visually increased[/p][p][/p][h3][b]OPTIMIZATION[/b][/h3][p]- Intro sequence refusing to play smoothly fixed[/p][p]- Anti-aliasing method changed[/p][p]- Various optimization and framerate improvements[/p][p][/p][h3][b]MISC[/b][/h3][p]- Watermark changed to better reflect the current scope of the build[/p][p]- Minor fix to mission not progressing in certain circumstances[/p][p]- Change to tutorial messages displayed during New Game[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]KNOWN BUGS & UPCOMING CHANGES[/h1][p]- Various animation desyncing issues[/p][p]- Speedlines re-enabled whilst sprinting, gliding, grappling etc.[/p][p]- Additional Camera System rework[/p][p]- Additional Rail Grind System rework[/p][p]- More "linear" tutorial mission[/p][p]- Increased Enemy Reactivity [b][i](More enemy types are planned for the full game which better reflect stance change needs)[/i][/b][/p][p]- Easy Swing Grapple Mode[/p][p]- UI Overhaul [b][i](much is currently placeholder)[/i][/b][/p][p]- Audio continued Overhaul[/p][p]- Various clipping issues[/p][p]- Further Optimization Works[/p][p]- Map Improvements [b][i](However this map does not reflect the maps of the full game, it is purely a separate set piece for the Alpha's gameplay mechanic testing using various assets from our different levels of the game)[/i][/b][i]

------
The feedback we receive is a huge part of shaping this game into what we know it can become. This Pre-Alpha is focused on showcasing the core gameplay, and getting early feedback on how it runs and whether people are having fun. We are hoping it shows the potential and secures the support we need to bring the full vision to life, including our full six chapter story. We are grateful for any and all your feedback.[/i][/p]
